Fieldnote: current system and next steps

Long image

A

Answer

Fieldnote now supports financial research without a model, optional OpenRouter review, and explicit connection checks. Broader company search and automatic research correction are the next stages.

Applies to28 Oct 2026working treelive checks deferred

1

What runs today?

Diagram structure
  • Research workspace browser
  • Local API api
  • One Python worker worker
  • Store store
  • SQLite sqlite
  • Source snapshots files
  • SEC annual facts sec
  • Selected model provider model
  • browser → api · HTTP
  • api → worker · enqueue
  • api → store · saved reads
  • worker → store · read/save
  • store → sqlite · transactions
  • store → files · source bytes
  • worker → sec · fresh only
  • worker → model · requested review

Python owns source selection, calculations, allowed checks and run limits. Store owns SQLite and snapshot writes. The API, worker and Store share one process.1 2 3

ConnectionCurrent behavior
SECAnnual USD financial facts for five supported companies; live access remains unchecked
Optional modelOpenAI, OpenRouter or a trusted compatible endpoint; structured interpretation and critic responses are validated
ConfigurationServer environment only; restart after changes; credentials stay on the server
Connections pageShows setup and current-session outcomes; opening or refreshing starts no provider calls
Explicit testsSEC uses MSFT without a model; model test uses saved evidence with consent, an allowance and provider-cap confirmation

Requests have no automatic paid retries or provider fallback. Reported usage is saved, including when output validation fails. Missing cost remains unknown. The allowance cannot guarantee a billing cap.4 1 5

Evidence scope

This page describes inspected, uncommitted files. Source copies and hashes are in evidence/; they are not presented as committed HEAD bytes. Implementation and mocked tests do not establish live access or financial correctness. Saved teaching examples and corrections remain synthetic.

2

What happens to a request?

Diagram structure
  • Named stock named
  • Discovery filters discovery
  • Run mode? mode
  • Saved replay replay
  • SEC + calculation fresh
  • Reuse saved packet frozen
  • Discovery? kind
  • Screen and select screen
  • Critic objections? critic
  • Draft interpretation draft
  • Model review? ready
  • Preserve partial results stop
  • Record unresolved checks checks
  • Saved report report
  • checks → report · unresolved
  • critic → checks · yes
  • critic → report · no
  • discovery → mode
  • draft → critic
  • fresh → kind
  • frozen → kind
  • kind → ready · no
  • kind → screen · yes
  • mode → fresh · fresh
  • mode → frozen · frozen
  • mode → replay · replay
  • named → mode
  • ready → draft · requested + ready
  • ready → report · off / unavailable
  • ready → stop · limit reached
  • replay → report · unchanged
  • screen → ready · selected
  • screen → report · none selected
PathResult
ReplayReopens saved evidence and output; no retrieval or model calls
FreshRetrieves eligible SEC facts and computes metrics; SEC contact setup is required
FrozenReuses the saved company, cutoff, evidence and metrics; new model analysis is optional
DiscoveryScreens five companies by sector and annual margin; eligible selection is alphabetical
Model off, unavailable or failedFinancial results remain available; model status is separate
Critic objectionRecords unresolved concerns and host checks; no automatic correction
Failure or shared limitPreserves available partial results; no automatic retry or resumption

The review path repeats for each selected company. Unknown values cannot pass a required filter. Recovered submissions reuse their original request and key.1 2 5

How does the research loop evolve?

Diagram structure
  • Research scope scope
  • Sources and facts facts
  • Draft claims draft
  • Risk review audit
  • Follow-up needed? follow
  • Allowed checks checks
  • Resolve and version resolve
  • Recalculate and screen screen
  • Research brief brief
  • audit → follow
  • checks → resolve · result
  • draft → audit
  • facts → draft
  • follow → brief · no
  • follow → checks · yes
  • resolve → screen · changes
  • scope → facts
  • screen → brief

The coordinator routes filings/events/quant work and synthesis within one application. Repeat review only within the shared budget; unresolved results retain their concerns. Dedicated event research remains planned.6

Planned boundaryRequired behavior
Evidence and calculationsPreserve original tables, typed facts, formula inputs and source dates
Correction loopTarget claim versions, run allowed checks, preserve resolutions, recalculate affected results and re-screen Discovery
Separate forecastingValidate a price model and score mature outcomes; narrative review cannot change its probability
4

How do we reach broader Discovery?

The five companies are today's supported universe and also have synthetic examples. SEC directory search will broaden identity lookup. Financial evidence and filters determine eligibility.6 2

Next checkpointUser-visible result
3 · Original filingCompare two saved Microsoft FY2024 figures with the original table
4 · Validated calculationsInspect a correct margin and a rejected company, period, currency or scope mismatch
5 · Company searchResearch a supported US filer outside the original five using the SEC directory
6 · Selected-list DiscoveryScreen up to ten selected companies; see passes, failures, unknowns and actual coverage

Wider automatic candidate sourcing follows these checkpoints. Add prices, events or news when a research question needs them; directory membership alone cannot rank a company. Live checks remain deferred under the setup-only choice.6
